_doc: Cases that the corpus freshness check should NOT treat as drift. Used only for the `missing` direction (JS has, Python deliberately doesn't). Extras (Python has, JS doesn't) are reported but never fail CI, so they don't need entries here. Add a comment in `_reasons` per entry so future maintainers know why something is excluded.

_reasons._example: evalCondition::case name -> short reason. Populate when we deliberately omit JS cases (e.g., they test a feature Python doesn't yet support and we don't intend to backport).
